raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-18 the payments source sends amount corrections in the regular delivery as a repeated txn_id with record_version=2. That explains the 30 duplicate txn_ids (4896 rows vs 4866 distinct ids, 30 rows at version 2). silver_transactions keeps both versions, so the gold tables double count. The fix keeps only the latest version per txn_id, chosen before the POSTED filter so a later version's status is respected.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
